description: This file defines the `MessageOnlyLogFilter` class, which implements the `LogNode` interface. Its purpose is to filter log output to only pass through the message content, suitable for simplified in-app logging displays.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only the message part of log entries, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
